Political Storm Erupts Over Delhi Police Entry into Bangla Sahib Gurdwara

A political storm has erupted over the entry of protesters and Delhi Police into the Bangla Sahib Gurdwara in Delhi. The incident has reportedly hurt Sikh sentiments, with one statement asserting that the gurdwara is not a stage for protesters and that attempts to drag it into "dirty politics" will not be tolerated. The situation has placed the gurdwara at the center of political controversy.
